highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, a Graphite-ready singleton lifecycle rework, and new GPU/interop APIs. This is a breaking release for some Vulkan and font-default consumers — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, not a lazy default
breaking.body: Upstream removed the lazy resolve-default-at-draw-time pattern, so an SKFont built without an explicit typeface now stores SKTypeface.Empty and measures/draws nothing. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) to keep the old behavior, and check font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SKPaint still draws text out of the box, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead, or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms are now consistent: an unknown family returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null. For a strict 'was it found' check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default now resolves through the font manager
breaking.body: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null on every platform, including Android API 36+ where it previously could return null. No migration needed for existing callers.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on out-of-range offsets and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload used to silently truncate offsets beyond int range; it now throws OverflowException and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 context
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a 1.0 instance/device causes a fatal, uncatchable process abort instead of CreateVulkan returning null. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 both when creating the VkInstance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave it at its default 0). 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to raster or another backend up front.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from this interop struct. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; there is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice since Skia no longer manages that ownership.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (adds a new Components field), and the old GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable or the equality operators. Update field types and replace equality-operator comparisons with manual field comparisons if needed.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through milestones m132 to m148
bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine from milestone 132 all the way to 148 across the 4.147.x previews, plus several chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color font support
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, and an HBColor struct for hb_color_t; also fixes default-typeface resolution to run in the managed layer.

bullets.lead: New stream, WebP and drawing APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion, animated WebP encoding via SKWebpEncoder, SKSamplingOptions support on SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and additional API wrappers with naming-convention fixes.

bullets.lead: Cleaned up the v4 obsolete surface
bullets.detail: Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsolete legacy paint text/font members and pre-v4 obsolete APIs to compile errors, trimming the obsolete enums from the reference assembly.

bullets.lead: Fixed pixel access and finalizer crashes
bullets.detail: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the generic-offset overload, and a finalizer crash in SKPath is fixed when its SKPathBuilder is collected first.

bullets.lead: Fixed WinUI and Apple platform issues
bullets.detail: Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, and corrects Apple platform TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned TFMs for apps.
Reworks how singleton native instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 native builds for Tizen, and PolySharp support for C# 13 features on legacy TFMs; drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten (WASM) versions.
Fixes SKGLView not rendering again after switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar.
Updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0, expat to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Reworked the singleton lifecycle, added variable font and color font support, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, added the Vulkan/legacy typeface fixes, and bumped Skia through milestones 132-147
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp support for C# 13 on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Reduced the SkiaFiddle WASM sample application size by about 60%
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the README
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line with the Skia milestone 132/147 bump, variable font and color font support, new WebP encoding and stream APIs, and expanded Bionic and Tizen native platform coverage.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Added animated WebP encoding, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, and corrected Apple platform TFMs for libraries and apps.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Continued the v4 engine sync with chrome/m147 bug fixes, dropped native builds for pre-.NET 8 WASM, and refreshed several bundled native dependencies for security.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Reworked the singleton lifecycle and native-compatibility gate, fixed the SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-span bugs, promoted remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to errors, and finished the Skia m148 bump ahead of the stable 4.148.0 release.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font shaping support and an HBColor value type, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
